paragraphs: Live fleet tracking for GT06-family, Teltonika, and optional mobile GPS. Includes customer workspaces, persistent locations, heartbeat/fix freshness, maps, recorded routes, geofences, alerts, documents, and an e-way register.

The customer app and serverless API run on Waypoint on Vercel. PostgreSQL provisioned through Vercel Storage owns customer accounts, sessions, fleet registrations, GPS history, documents, e-way records and preferences. Private Vercel Blob owns attachments. Oracle runs only Traccar TCP reception and the GPS forwarding worker. Live tracking, route history, devices, geofences, alerts, Documents, E-way bills, Profile, and Settings share one navigation shell. Customer login, sign-up, and admin login are separate screens. Drivers use separate vehicle links.

The production site does not expose demo mode. Customer accounts, fleet data, documents, e-way register entries, and display preferences are stored on the cloud server and scoped to each workspace. Document and bill attachments are limited to 2 MB each. The e-way register is manual; it does not create or modify government records.
